def factor_overnight_intraday_smoothed_normalized(df):
    """Smoothed overnight-intraday dissonance normalized by average compressed session magnitude."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight, intraday = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    overnight = overnight.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    intraday = intraday.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    signed_sqrt_overnight = np.sign(overnight) * np.sqrt(np.abs(overnight))
    signed_sqrt_intraday = np.sign(intraday) * np.sqrt(np.abs(intraday))
    raw_dissonance = signed_sqrt_overnight - signed_sqrt_intraday
    smoothed = raw_dissonance.rolling(5, min_periods=1).mean()
    total_magnitude = (np.sqrt(np.abs(overnight)) + np.sqrt(np.abs(intraday))).rolling(5, min_periods=1).mean()
    factor = (smoothed / total_magnitude.replace(0.0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0)
    df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_smoothed_normalized"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_smoothed_normalized"]
description: Primary mechanism from elite parent: 5-day smoothed signed square-root overnight-intraday dissonance captures persistent disagreement between overnight/global and intraday/local trading. Lightweight modifier from secondary parent: normalize by rolling mean of total compressed session magnitude (sum of square-root absolute returns) to reduce cross-stock scale sensitivity, improving comparability while preserving the raw economic signal. This normalization is bounded by the same trailing window and uses only past observations. Cross-sectional transform remains none because the raw smoothed dissonance already works well after industry+size neutralization in parent evidence.
